content: Devin, SWE-agent, OpenHands are single-agent autonomous coders in sandboxed runtimes that plan/write/run/debug until tests pass. SWE-agent is eval-focused (agent-computer interface), weak on open-ended prod work. All degrade sharply on multi-file/evolving codebases (GPT-5+OpenHands ~21% SWE-EVO vs 65% SWE-Bench Verified). They focus on task autonomy, not orchestration, durable state, role separation, or independent verification.
